entries.title: Same Prompt, Ten Times
entries.description: Run one identical prompt through a model ten times and read the disagreement between the results as a map of where it is least grounded.

entries.title: Building Badly on Purpose
entries.description: A log of deliberately crude first builds and what each one exposed that a careful build would have hidden.

entries.title: The Reconstruction Exercise
entries.description: Testing whether reconstructing the decision history of an admired work transfers to better decisions in your own.

entries.title: Writing Without the Instrument
entries.description: A planned month of unassisted daily writing, measured against a baseline, to see which capacities recover and how fast.
